```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
report <- params$report_data
```

## Summary

This report provides a comprehensive overview of the MultiConnector analysis performed.

### Data Overview

```{r data_overview}
if (!is.null(report$summary$data_overview)) {
    summ <- report$summary$data_overview
    cat("The analysis included", summ$n_subjects, "subjects and", summ$n_measures, "measures.\n")
    cat("Total number of time points analyzed:", summ$n_timepoints, "\n")
    cat("Time range:", paste(summ$time_range, collapse = " to "), "\n")
    cat("Measures included:", paste(summ$measures, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r clustering_analysis, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(report$clustering_results) && length(report$clustering_results) > 0) {
    for (model_name in names(report$clustering_results)) {
        res <- report$clustering_results[[model_name]]

        cat("\n\n# Model Analysis:", model_name, "{.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}\n\n")

        # --- Summary Sub-tab ---
        cat("\n\n## Model Summary\n\n")
        cat("- **Number of clusters (G):**", res$summary$n_clusters, "\n")
        cat("- **H parameter:**", res$summary$h_parameter, "\n")

        p_param <- res$summary$p_parameter
        if (is.vector(p_param) && !is.null(names(p_param))) {
            cat("- **Spline dimensions (p):**\n")
            for (m_name in names(p_param)) {
                cat("    -", m_name, ":", p_param[m_name], "\n")
            }
        } else {
            cat("- **Spline dimension (p):**", p_param, "\n")
        }

        cat("- **Cluster names:**", paste(res$summary$cluster_names, collapse = ", "), "\n")

        if (!is.null(res$tables$cluster_assignments)) {
            cat("\n\n### Cluster Assignments\n")
            print(knitr::kable(res$tables$cluster_assignments))
        }

        # --- Visualizations Sub-tab ---
        cat("\n\n## Visualizations {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}\n\n")

        cat("\n\n### Base Classification\n\n")
        print(res$plots$cluster_plot_basic)
        cat("\n\n")

        if (!is.null(res$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature) && length(res$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature) > 0) {
            for (feat in names(res$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature)) {
                cat("\n\n### Feature: ", feat, "\n\n")
                print(res$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature[[feat]])
                cat("\n\n")
                print(knitr::kable(x = res$tables[[feat]]))
                cat("\n\n")
            }
        }

        # --- Validation Sub-tab ---
        if (!is.null(res$plots$validation_plot)) {
            cat("\n\n## Validation\n\n")
            print(res$plots$validation_plot)
            cat("\n\n")
        }

        # --- Discriminant Sub-tab ---
        if (!is.null(res$plots$discriminant_plot) || !is.null(res$plots$maxdiscriminant_plot)) {
            cat("\n\n## Discriminant Analysis\n\n")

            if (!is.null(res$plots$discriminant_plot)) {
                for (i in seq_along(res$plots$discriminant_plot)) {
                    print(res$plots$discriminant_plot[[i]])
                    cat("\n\n")
                }
            }

            if (!is.null(res$plots$maxdiscriminant_plot)) {
                print(res$plots$maxdiscriminant_plot)
                cat("\n\n")
                print(knitr::kable(x = res$tables$discriminant_areas, caption = "Relative importance of measures in clustering."))
                cat("\n\n")
            }
        }

        # --- Spline Plots Sub-tab ---
        if (!is.null(res$plots$spline_plots) && length(res$plots$spline_plots) > 0) {
            cat("\n\n## Spline Plots\n\n")

            splines <- res$plots$spline_plots
            subj_ids <- names(splines)

            # Simple list/selector for splines within this model
            # To avoid JS conflicts with multiple models, we use unique IDs
            safe_name <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", model_name)
            selector_id <- paste0("subj_selector_", safe_name)
            container_prefix <- paste0("spline_cont_", safe_name, "_")

            cat('<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">')
            cat("  <label>Select Subject: </label>")
            cat('  <select id="', selector_id, '" onchange="showSplinePlot_', safe_name, '(this.value)">', sep = "")
            for (i in seq_along(subj_ids)) {
                selected <- if (i == 1) " selected" else ""
                cat('    <option value="', subj_ids[i], '"', selected, ">", subj_ids[i], "</option>", sep = "")
            }
            cat("  </select>")
            cat("</div>")

            for (i in seq_along(subj_ids)) {
                display_style <- if (i == 1) "display: block;" else "display: none;"
                cat('<div id="', container_prefix, subj_ids[i], '" class="spline-plot-div-', safe_name, '" style="', display_style, '">', sep = "")
                print(splines[[i]])
                cat("</div>")
            }

            cat("\n<script>\n")
            cat("function showSplinePlot_", safe_name, "(subjectId) {\n", sep = "")
            cat('  var buckets = document.getElementsByClassName("spline-plot-div-', safe_name, '");\n', sep = "")
            cat('  for (var i = 0; i < buckets.length; i++) { buckets[i].style.display = "none"; }\n')
            cat('  var selected = document.getElementById("', container_prefix, '" + subjectId);\n', sep = "")
            cat('  if (selected) { selected.style.display = "block"; }\n')
            cat("}\n")
            cat("</script>\n")
        }
    }
}
```
